name: Elara Swift
description: A former royal guard who left service after her brother disappeared. Quiet, observant, relentless.
goal: Find my brother. He vanished near the river three weeks ago. Someone in this market knows something.
notes: Prefers problem-solving over fighting. Has a soft spot for stray animals.

name: Ronn the Spice-Merchant
description: Loud, cheerful, always has a lead on city gossip. Secretly funds a small rescue crew.
goal: Keep an ear out for trouble. Help Elara if she asks but don't reveal the rescue crew unless necessary.
knowledge: Elara's brother was last seen heading toward the Old Spice Cellar
Strange lights have been reported in the cellar at night
A group called the Marsh Raiders has been kidnapping travelers
